Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild the same setup from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or checking in on a teammate's workload, you can save that configuration once and return to it in a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, or personal workflow. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters individually — making handoffs and status updates far more consistent.

Saved Views is rolling out now across all paid plans, with no extra setup required. We think it'll quickly become part of your daily routine for staying on top of work.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
